## 2. Comprehensive Service Catalog & Modalities

### A. Non-Surgical Spine Decompression & Traction
- Cervical Intermittent Mechanical Traction: Computerized neck traction that gently decompresses cervical vertebrae C1-C7 to relieve pinched nerve roots, radiating arm tingling, and chronic tension headaches.
- Lumbar Intermittent Mechanical Traction: Precise lower back decompression targeting disc herniations at L4-L5 and L5-S1. Creates negative intradiscal pressure to pull back bulging disc material and relieve sciatica leg nerve pain.

### B. Specialized Manual & Myofascial Therapies
- Maitland & Mulligan Joint Mobilization: Expert hands-on joint glide techniques to restore lost range of motion and joint capsule fluidity without pain.
- Dry Needling Therapy: Filiform needle insertion into myofascial trigger points to instantly deactivate stubborn muscle knots and spasms.
- Hijama & Cupping Suite:
  * Dry Cupping: Myofascial suction decompression to separate muscle fascia and increase localized blood circulation.
  * Wet / Hijama Cupping: Medicinal hygienic micro-detoxification that removes stagnant metabolic waste and reduces chronic inflammatory pain.
- IASTM (Instrument-Assisted Soft Tissue Mobilization): Ergonomic stainless-steel contoured instruments that detect and breakdown deep scar tissue, tendonitis adhesions, and chronic muscular tightness.
- Kinesiology Taping (K-Tape): Athletic elastic taping for joint stabilization, proprioceptive feedback, and swelling reduction during movement.

### C. Advanced Electrotherapy & Modalities
- TENS (Transcutaneous Electrical Nerve Stimulation): Electrical pulse stimulation that blocks pain signal transmission to the brain and triggers endorphin release.
- IFT (Interferential Therapy): Dual medium-frequency currents penetrating deep inside tissues for joint swelling, osteoarthritis, and deep muscle spasms.
- US Therapy (Therapeutic Ultrasound): Acoustic sound wave therapy that produces deep thermal heating inside collagen fibers to soften scar tissue and accelerate cellular tissue repair.
- Electrical Muscle Stimulation (EMS): Muscle re-education current to prevent post-op muscle atrophy and restore firing in weak muscle groups.
- Acupressure & Electro-Acupuncture: Traditional meridian pressure point stimulation integrated with mild electrical currents for fast neurological pain suppression.

### D. Targeted Clinical Conditions Treated
1. Slip Disc & Lumbar Sciatica (92% Non-surgical resolution rate)
2. Knee Osteoarthritis & Cartilage Degeneration (94% Non-surgical relief rate)
3. Cervical Spondylosis, Neck Stiffness & Radiating Arm Numbness
4. Frozen Shoulder (Adhesive Capsulitis - range of motion recovery)
5. Stroke, Hemiplegia & Paralysis Neurological Rehabilitation
6. Sports Injuries (ACL / MCL ligament sprains, meniscus tears, hamstring pulls)
7. Heel Pain, Plantar Fasciitis, Ankle Sprains, Tennis Elbow
8. Posture Alignment, Ergonomics & Non-Invasive Body Slimming

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
Q: Is Dr. Sohan Lal available on Sundays?
A: Yes, Sanjeevani Physiotherapy Clinic is open all 7 days of the week from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, including Sundays.

Q: Can slip disc be treated without surgery?
A: Yes! Over 90% of slip disc and sciatica cases respond successfully to targeted non-surgical intermittent lumbar traction, spinal mobilization, dry needling, and core stabilization.
